description: This file defines an abstract class 'GenericMap' which implements the Java Map interface. It manages a generic key-value mapping with custom iterators, thread-safe updates to collections, and internal logic for equality and hash code. The class appears to be a part of a utilities package within the Apache OFBiz framework, providing a foundation for creating custom map implementations.

classes.name: GenericMap
classes.description: An abstract class implementing the Map interface with thread-safe collection handling and custom iteration logic.

classes.name: GenericMapIterator
classes.description: Inner class extending IteratorWrapper, used for iterating over map entries or keys with concurrent modification checks.

methods.name: getModCount
methods.description: Returns the current modification count of the map.

methods.name: incrementModCount
methods.description: Atomically increments the internal modification count.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the map by invoking an abstract clearInternal method if not empty.

methods.name: containsValue
methods.description: Checks if the map contains a given value.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code based on keySet, entrySet, and values collections.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Determines equality with another object, supporting comparison with both GenericMap and Map instances.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value for the specified key, with optional access noting.

methods.name: entrySet
methods.description: Returns a set of key-value entries, initializing it if not already created.

methods.name: keySet
methods.description: Returns a set of keys, initializing it if not already created.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns a collection of values, initializing it if not already created.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the mapping for a given key and updates mod count.

methods.name: putAll
methods.description: Adds all mappings from another map into this map.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the map.

methods.name: appendTo
methods.description: Appends a string representation of the map to a StringBuilder.
